title: Gus and the Vet
lines: Gus has a tan cat. It has a cut.
"The vet can fix it," said Mom.
Mom gets the van, but the cat hid!
Gus got it and set it on his lap.
The vet gets a wet rag and dabs it.
"You have a big, tan cat," he said.
Gus hugs it. The cat naps in the van.

questions.ask: Why did Gus take the cat to the vet?
questions.listenFor: The cat had a cut. It is in the first line. If they say "it was sick," ask them to find the words that tell us.

questions.ask: How do you know the cat did not want to go?
questions.listenFor: The cat hid when Mom got the van. That is evidence, not a guess - have them find the line and read it back.

questions.ask: Do you think the cat will hide next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. You want a reason from the story - the vet was gentle and used a wet rag on the cut, or the cat hid at the start anyway. The because is the point.
